profile.name: Bijaya Acharya
profile.headline: AI / ML engineering · MSc Data Analytics
profile.summary: I build applied machine learning systems, from training small language models and fine-tuning vision–language models to building tool-using agents, APIs, and analytics pipelines. MSc Data Analytics student at the University of Hildesheim.
profile.availability: Open to working-student and research roles · 20 h/week during semester
profile.workAuthorization: German student residence permit · Full-time during semester breaks

experience.organization: NAAMII · Nepal Applied Mathematics and Informatics Institute for Research
details: Built and evaluated ML workflows for imbalanced clinical cancer datasets, supporting interpretation of model outputs.
Contributed analysis, research support, and documentation to an IEEE Early Access publication.
Developed and deployed Python-based ML and data solutions for small-business use cases.
Worked across teams on analytics, automation, and practical delivery requirements.

publication.title: Machine Learning Models Predicting Radiation Pneumonitis Based on a Multi-Omics and Multi-Regional Approach in Patients with Lung Cancer Treated on the NRG/RTOG 0617 Clinical Trial

projects.title: MRAgent
projects.description: Local Python AI agent extending nanobot with a streaming web interface, voice input, tool use, MCP integrations, scheduling, and model-provider setup.

projects.title: NovaMind 256M
projects.description: Designed and trained a ~256M-parameter conversational transformer from scratch, including pretraining, instruction tuning, and H100-based training.

projects.title: SketchAWQ
projects.description: Experimental post-training quantization pipeline studying lightweight Hessian-sketch signals for AWQ-style scaling, with reproducible evaluation configurations.

projects.title: Radiology VLM
